content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Montgomery

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience to sit for the PMP exam. Review PMI's documented eligibility criteria—typically a combination of formal education and years leading projects. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your qualifications and clarify any questions before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy delivers the required 35 contact hours through live-virtual, instructor-led classes you attend from anywhere. Our curriculum covers the PMBOK Guide, real-world case studies, and exam domains. You'll learn alongside other professionals from Montgomery's Government, Aerospace, Healthcare, and Automotive sectors—all on a schedule that fits your work.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application & Exam Fee
steps_items.text: After finishing your training, submit your formal application directly to PMI, including proof of your contact hours from Granite PM Academy. Pay PMI's exam fee and allow time for application processing. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the submission process and answer questions about documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Test for the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources—practice tests, strategy sessions, and Q&A support—to build your confidence. You'll sit for the computer-based PMP exam at a PMI-approved testing center on a date of your choosing. Our instructors remain available to address final questions before you test.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP is valid for three years. During that cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by attending training, teaching, or contributing to project-management work. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to help you renew on schedule and stay current with industry best practices.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
